parameters_excerpt:
```text
per-channel token:
Linear(16,64) -> GELU -> Linear(64,64) -> GELU
channel-token mean pooling
Linear(64,64) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(64,1)

parameter_count = 9,473
loss = 0.5 * mean BT-NLL(source A) + 0.5 * mean BT-NLL(source B)
optimizer = AdamW
lr = 1e-3
weight_decay = 1e-4
batch_size = 256
max_epochs = 30
patience = 5
seed = 20260817
```

每个 epoch 每个 source 精确消费 44,839 pairs，共 351 个 cycles；每域为 `262×128 + 89×127`，两域合计为 `173×256 + 178×255`。Checkpoint 只按两个 source 的 macro validation BT-NLL 选择，目标 VAE 没有 validation metric。

Best epoch / source macro validation NLL / 实际训练 epochs：`loo_dcae=1 / 0.688377 / 6`，`loo_flux=3 / 0.687711 / 8`，`loo_sd=3 / 0.685303 / 8`。
